blocks.v: Welcome to TAM, a productivity RPG developed by SATER Studio. We are committed to protecting your privacy while you embark on your hero's journey.
TAM operates on a local-first basis.

v: No PII Collection: We do not collect, store, or transmit Personal Identifiable Information (PII) to external servers.
Local Storage: Your tasks, XP, levels, and RPG stats (FOC, SOL, NRG) are stored exclusively on your device's local database.

blocks.v: To provide the full RPG experience, TAM requires the following permissions:

v: RECORD_AUDIO (Soul Echoes / Voice Vault): Used only to allow you to record voice notes. These recordings stay on your device and are never uploaded.
POST_NOTIFICATIONS: Used to display the "Golden Icon" (Crown) in your status bar during focus sessions and to notify you of victories.
VIBRATE: Used for haptic feedback (Double-Pulse) to celebrate task completion and session ends.

blocks.v: TAM requests storage access for the sole purpose of:

v: SaterPdfExporter: Allowing you to generate and save productivity reports as PDF files directly to your device.

blocks.v: We use standard, trusted Flutter libraries (such as flutter_local_notifications and audioplayers).

v: No Analytics/Ads: This initial version of TAM does not use third-party advertising or tracking SDKs.

blocks.v: TAM is a tool for productivity. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13.
For any inquiries regarding your privacy or the SATER_ ecosystem, contact us at: sater.studios@gmail.com

Voice Vault: Encrypted local storage for audio logs and "Soul Echoes".

blocks.v: I want to inform you that whenever you use my Service, in a case of an error in the app I collect data and information (through third party products) on your phone called Log Data. This Log Data may include information such as your device Internet Protocol (“IP”) address, device name, operating system version, the configuration of the app when utilizing my Service, the time and date of your use of the Service, and other statistics.

The app requires access to your device's sensors (specifically the Accelerometer and Gyroscope) to function properly. This sensor data is used solely for gameplay mechanics (to detect motion and orientation during the game). This data is processed in real-time on your device and is never recorded, stored, or transmitted to any server.

We use Google AdMob to display ads. AdMob may use your device's Advertising ID to serve personalized ads based on your interests. You can opt-out of personalized advertising by visiting your device settings (Google > Ads > Opt out of Ads Personalization).

These Services do not address anyone under the age of 13. I do not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13. In the case I discover that a child under 13 has provided me with personal information, I immediately delete this from our servers. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal information, please contact me so that I will be able to do necessary actions.

I may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Thus, you are advised to review this page periodically for any changes. I will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page.
If you have any questions or suggestions about my Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact me at: sater.studios@gmail.com

ZILL operates with a Local-First Philosophy. We believe your travel data belongs to you.

To calculate sun angles relative to your vehicle, ZILL requires access to your device's location (GPS). Crucially, this data is processed locally on your device in real-time. We do not transmit, store, or sell your location history to any external servers. The mathematical calculations happen instantly on your phone.
We do not collect personal identifiable information (PII). The app functions as a standalone utility tool.
The app may use standard Google Play Services for core functionality, subject to their own privacy policies.
